title: Scan run table
description: scan.json in a commitwork scan run directory: one row per scanned repository and one cell per check, exactly as cmdScan in bin/commitwork.mjs classified them, so a brief can be rebuilt from the directory later (commitwork brief --from). This schema fixes the envelope, the row and the fields a cell shares. A cell carries further detail depending on how its lane ended (blocked, timedOut and so on); those fields are not frozen here, so further properties are allowed on a cell. Each lane's threat model is stored once under boundaries and referenced from its cells; the model is bin/lib/isolation.mjs's and only its version and state are fixed here.

baseline.description: The manifest's repo field: which check set ran.

boundaries.description: Present when any cell carries a threat model. Keyed by the sha256 of the model's JSON.

slug.description: Its directory name in the run, unique within the run.

sev.description: ok is the only clean value. noscan is a lane that did not produce a usable result, which is neither a pass nor a finding; skip is a lane that did not apply.
